Summary

Every branch of universitybikeshop.com as a tree, down to each download. The site has 219 pages: 12 public pages in the navigation bar, 188 unlisted pages that search engines may index, and 19 unlisted pages kept out of search engines. Below them sit 293 downloadable files (307 MB in all). Grey folder names are URL segments with no page of their own; where one has a section on its parent page, the name links there.
